name: Trapped chests and chest openers
note: Trapped chests pair with trapped chests only and are containers as chests are; each chest half counts the players viewing it and queues its lid's block event with the count at every change and every 5-tick recheck while viewed; a trapped chest gives its count as power on every side and strongly to the block below, and dust connects to it; the harness traces and a 14-step client scenario with two players match both official servers
deviations: the open and close sounds and the game events sculk sensors hear are not modeled
